name: app-lavender-design-process-four-circles-in-a-diamond
title: Design Process in Four Circles
whatItIs: A lavender slide titled Design Process with a plane progress bar and four large soft circles arranged in a diamond around a centre logo: Visual Design, Wireframing, User Flow and Research, each with a title on a white cap and a short description, joined by faint double lines.
whatItMeans: A diamond of soft circles makes a process feel cyclical and complete, and the logo at the centre ties it to the brand.
techniques: Four circles at the corners of a diamond
Logo in a small circle at the centre
Titles on white segments at the top of each circle

vocabulary.definition: Four items placed at the points of a diamond.
A soft-shadowed circle that looks gently raised.
A logo at the middle of a diagram.
